# `askAgent(options.provider, [options.messages], [options.prompt], [options.system], [options.history], [options.images], [options.documents], [options.tools], [options.toolHandlers], [options.documentResolver], [options.mcpServers], [options.preSearch], [options.webSearch], [options.maxToolRounds], [options.includeDiagnostics], [options.signal])`

[External Documentation](https://github.com/rdsslab/libOpenFusionAPI) 

Provider-agnostic agent turn on top of `ia.js`. Adds deterministic web pre-search for weak models, local tools (including `web_search`), in-memory document injection, optional MCP servers, and returns a single envelope with the answer, search results and diagnostics. Works with Ollama, OpenAI-compatible providers, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Anthropic and Gemini.

**Notes**

- The deterministic pre-search fixes the common failure of small local models that answer "no tengo acceso a internet" even when a search tool is available.
- Documents are extracted before the model call because JS handlers have no filesystem: pass the bytes, not a path.
- A `MediaProviderError`, `DocumentExtractionError` or `AgentError` carries a `userMessage` that can be shown to the end user verbatim.

**Agent Guidance**

- Prefer `askAgent` over `askIAWithMCP` when you need web access or document reading: it does the plumbing for you.
- Keep `maxToolRounds` low (2-4) for slow local models; each round is a full prompt processing pass.

**Parameters**

*   `options.provider` <object|string> Provider configuration (same shape as `askIAWithMCP`), or a preset name such as `ollama`, `openai`, `openai-compatible`, `openrouter`, `deepseek`, `anthropic` or `google-gemini`. Must include `model`.
*   `options.messages` <array<object>|string> **Optional**. Conversation messages, oldest first: `[{ role, content }]`. Content may be a string or an array of text/image parts.
*   `options.prompt` <string> **Optional**. Shorthand for a single user message.
*   `options.system` <string> **Optional**. System prompt prepended to the conversation.
*   `options.history` <array<object>> **Optional**. Prior conversation, oldest first, prepended to `messages`.
*   `options.images` <array<any>> **Optional**. Images for the last user turn: Buffers, base64 strings, data URLs or `{ mimeType, data }`.
*   `options.documents` <array<any>> **Optional**. In-memory documents whose text is extracted and injected into the prompt. Accepts Buffers, base64, data URLs or `{ data, mimeType, fileName }`. Supported: PDF, DOCX and text formats.
*   `options.tools` <object> **Optional**. Tools to enable: `{ web_search: true, read_document: true, [customName]: { handler, inputSchema } }`. A plain function is accepted as a shorthand handler.
*   `options.toolHandlers` <object> **Optional**. Extra local tool handlers merged into `tools` (same shape as `askIAWithMCP`).
*   `options.documentResolver` <function> **Optional**. Optional `async ({ name, id }) => document` used by the `read_document` tool when documents are not injected directly.
*   `options.mcpServers` <array<object>> **Optional**. MCP servers connected for this turn, same shape as `askIAWithMCP`.
*   `options.preSearch` <boolean|string> **Optional**. Default: `auto`. Deterministic web search before the model: `"auto"` (default, only when the text asks for fresh data), `true`/`"always"` (always), or `false` (never).
*   `options.webSearch` <object> **Optional**. Options forwarded to the search helper: `providers`, `maxResults`, `timeoutMs`, `fetchImpl`...
*   `options.maxToolRounds` <integer> **Optional**. Default: `4`. Maximum tool rounds before forcing a final answer.
*   `options.includeDiagnostics` <boolean> **Optional**. When true, the result includes full documents and the `ia.js` diagnostics object.
*   `options.signal` <AbortSignal> **Optional**. Optional AbortSignal to cancel the request.

*   Returns: <object> Promise resolving to one envelope for every provider.

    **Result Structure:**

    *   `text` <string> Assistant answer.
    *   `usedWeb` <boolean> True when web results were injected into the prompt.
    *   `webQuery` <string> Query used by the deterministic pre-search.
    *   `webResults` <array<object>> Results `{ title, url, snippet }`.
    *   `webSource` <string|null> Engine that answered the search.
    *   `webErrors` <array<string>> Per-provider search errors, when any.
    *   `documents` <array<object>> Metadata of the injected documents.
    *   `toolExecutions` <array<object>> Summary `{ tool, server, ok, deduplicated }`.
    *   `hasTools` <boolean> True when any tool was offered to the model.
    *   `diagnostics` <object> Full `ia.js` diagnostics when `includeDiagnostics` is true.

#### Example

```javascript

const answer = await askAgent({
  provider: {
    provider: 'ollama',
    model: 'llama3.2:3b',
    baseUrl: $_APP_VARS_['$_VAR_OLLAMA_URL'],
  },
  system: 'Responde en espanol, breve.',
  messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Busca el precio del dolar hoy' }],
  tools: { web_search: true },
  preSearch: 'auto',
});

$_RETURN_DATA_ = { text: answer.text, usedWeb: answer.usedWeb };
      
```
